notes_for_editor: The only history is one 1966 federal survey station record, reprinted on the Forest Lookouts page, plus a map-database listing that proves the name is mapped, not that the tower stands. No build date, agency, staffing or later record was found. The 30.5 m height is an approximation of the record's 'about 100 FT' (100 ft is 30.48 m). A directory listing (anyplaceamerica, returned HTTP 403 and not used) gives aliases 'Smith Fire Tower' and 'Smith Lookout Tower'. Unverified, so not in the story or other_names; check before adding. The NHLR and FFLOS Alabama lists (checked 2026-10-21) show no Meek entry. The station record has no coordinates, so the TopoQuest point cannot be matched to it by location; the link rests only on name, county and quadrangle.
